course.title: Commerce11th - NIRBHAY
course.description:
• NIRBHAY Batch – Class 11th Commerce
  • The most powerful and fearless Crash Course & Revision Batch for Class 11 Final Exam 2026.
  • Complete Coverage of All Subjects of Class 11 Science: Accountancy, Economics, Business Studies, Applied Maths, English & Hindi. 
  • Live Interactive Classes (2 Hours): Concepts + Numericals + Exam focussed questions explained clearly. 
  • Recordings Available 24×7: Complete class recordings will be available on Next Toppers App/Website.
  • School Timing Friendly Schedule: Classes will be planned according to your school hours. No clash with school studies.
  • Two Live Classes Every Day: Each class = 2hours. Final timings will be shared in the Orientation Session.
  • Doubt solving class after every chapter completion. 
  • Weekly Schedule Provided: A fixed weekly timetable will be given.
  • PDF Notes After Every Class: Chapter-wise notes in PDF format. Available on the Next Toppers App/Website.
  • Regular Tests for Practice: Chapter-wise tests, Full syllabus mock tests for Final Exam 2026.
  • English, Hindi in Recorded Form — everything will be available till your last exam. 
  •  Batch Timeline: Classes start from 1st December 2025 and revision of syllabus completed by mid-Jan
